title: 第380章 打坏了你赔得起吗第379章 王国与高庭
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路
content_zh:
第380章打坏了，你赔得起吗？
瓦伦汀的眼底极其隐蔽地掠过一丝轻蔑。
贪婪，短视。
果然，泥坑里爬出来的虫子，哪怕侥幸长出了几根毒刺，也改不掉这股闻见荤腥就想咬一口的穷酸做派。
不让他们见识一下王国与【人类高庭】真正的伟力，这帮土著永远不知道自己面对的究竟是怎样的存在。
瓦伦汀并未将不屑形于色。
他慢条斯理地将脱下的白手套对折，塞进胸前的口袋。
那张苍白的脸上依旧挂着彬彬有礼的微笑，只是那股居高临下的傲慢，却早已顺着眼角满溢出来。
“亚修阁下，您想要诚意，这无可厚非。但在此之前，我想您对王国制定的规矩恐怕有些什么误解。”
瓦伦汀背负着双手，皮靴在青石板上踩出清脆的声响：
“奥兰多王陛下固然求贤若渴，但高庭的光辉，也不是什么人都能沾染的。”
“寻常流民聚落想要并入王国，若无特殊建树，最多只能赐予‘勋爵’之衔，受王国庇护。”
“但若你能展露出完整的三阶实力，王室或许会看在你这份勇武的份上，破格赐你一个‘男爵’的世袭爵位。”
说到这，瓦伦汀忽然笑了。
笑容里满是毫不掩饰的讥诮：
“至于你自封的这个‘子爵’嘛……”
“阁下莫不是以为，杀了两头迷雾里的畜生，自己扯块破布做旗，就能自封子爵了？”
“在王国，只有牧守一方、替陛下管理十数万人口的一方重臣，才配享用‘子爵’的头衔！”
“区区一座破落小城，几千个面黄肌瘦的泥腿子……自称子爵，您这僭越得未免也太可笑了些吧？”
“放你娘的狗臭屁！”

亚修还没开口，站在后面的巴顿实在憋不住了。
他猛地一步跨出，指着瓦伦汀的鼻子，唾沫星子横飞：
“什么狗屁王国规矩！在我新烬城，亚修大哥的话就是规矩！”
“张口三阶闭口三阶，三阶算个什么稀罕玩意儿？真当就你们有是不是？！”
“哦？”
瓦伦汀非但没有动怒，反而像是听到了某种极其无知的狂言，发出了一阵低低的嗤笑。
“无知的蛮子，你可能误会了什么。”
“我口中所说的‘三阶’，指的可是由拥有至高血脉的封君亲自主持仪典、受领敕赐的‘正统骑士’。”
瓦伦汀指向身边那两名铁塔般的银甲巨汉，神色陡然变得肃穆狂热：
“我身边这两位，皆是由王室爵贵亲手点燃本源、受领王室权能敕赐的真正强者。”
“这，才是真正受到高庭认可的、完美的三阶骑士！”
“岂是你们这些在烂泥里靠着污染变异的‘伪三阶’，所能比拟的？！”
这话一出。
content_en:
Chapter 380 If it’s damaged, can you afford to pay for it?
There was a very hidden trace of contempt in Valentin's eyes.
Greedy, short-sighted.
Sure enough, even if the bug crawling out of the mud pit is lucky enough to grow a few poisonous stings, it can't change its poor behavior and want to bite it when it smells meat.
If they are not allowed to see the true power of the Kingdom and [Humanity Highgarden], these natives will never know what kind of existence they are facing.
Valentine did not express his disdain clearly.
He slowly folded the white gloves he took off in half and stuffed them into his breast pocket.
There was still a polite smile on that pale face, but that condescending arrogance had already overflowed from the corners of his eyes.
"Your Excellency Ash, it is understandable that you want to be sincere. But before that, I think you may have some misunderstandings about the rules set by the kingdom."
Valentine put his hands behind his back, and his leather boots made a crisp sound on the bluestone:
"His Majesty King Orlando is certainly thirsty for talents, but not just anyone can be tainted by the glory of Highgarden."
"Ordinary refugee settlements that want to be integrated into the kingdom, and if they have no special achievements, can only be given the title of 'Lord' and be protected by the kingdom."
"But if you can show your complete third-level strength, the royal family may consider your bravery and give you the hereditary title of 'Baron'."
Speaking of this, Valentin suddenly laughed.
The smile was full of unabashed sarcasm:
"As for your self-proclaimed 'Viscount'..."
"Does your Excellency think that by killing two beasts in the fog and making a flag out of a piece of rag, you can proclaim yourself a viscount?"
"In the kingdom, only the ministers on the pastoral side who manage hundreds of thousands of people for Your Majesty are worthy of the title of 'Viscount'!"
"It's just a run-down small town, with thousands of sallow and thin mud-legged people... Calling yourself a Viscount, isn't it too ridiculous for you to be so overreaching?"
"Fuck your motherfucker!"
Before Ash could speak, Barton, who was standing behind him, couldn't hold it in any longer.
He took a sudden step forward and pointed at Valentine's nose, spittle flying everywhere:
"What bullshit kingdom rules! In our new Ember City, Brother Ash's words are the rules!"
"Open your mouth to the third level and close your mouth to the third level. What kind of rare thing is the third level? You really are the only ones who have it, right?!"
"Oh?"
Instead of getting angry, Valentine seemed to have heard some extremely ignorant arrogance and let out a low laugh.
"Ignorant barbarian, you may have misunderstood something."
"The 'third level' I'm talking about refers to the 'orthodox knights' who are personally presided over by the lord with the highest bloodline and receive the imperial edict."
Valentine pointed at the two giant men in silver armor who looked like iron towers beside him, and his expression suddenly became solemn and fanatical:
"The two people beside me are both truly strong men who were personally ignited by the royal nobles and received the power of the royal family."
"This is the perfect third-order knight who is truly recognized by the High Court!"
"How can you, the 'pseudo-third-order' people who mutate in the mud relying on pollution, be able to compare to this?!"
As soon as these words came out.
